reviewer: Codex, final light/dark contact sheets and front/side pose sheets inspected
limits: Local procedural demonstration review; physical device and production checks pending. Sampled body clearance is not exhaustive mesh collision certification.

checks.exercise: Standing-start Romanian deadlift with hip hinge and soft knees.
checks.equipment: Rigid hexagonal trap bar with two side handles and plates; visible in both themes.
checks.setup: Starts and ends standing within the frame; no floor pickup depicted.
checks.hands: Both side grips follow the bar; elbows remain 175 degrees and frame stays level.
checks.feet: Both feet remain planted through the hinge.
checks.movement: Hips move back and return smoothly; corrected rear frame clears sampled leg and torso vertices; loop error zero over 481 samples.

checks.exercise: Bilateral calf raise on a step with trap bar.
checks.equipment: Rigid trap bar, two plates and step visible without cropping.
checks.setup: Forefeet on the step with heels free behind its rear edge.
checks.hands: Long arms hold side handles; elbows 175 degrees and grip width stable.
checks.feet: Forefoot support clearance zero over 481 samples; heels clear the rear edge.
checks.movement: Controlled rise, top pause and monotonic lowering; no upward heel rebound during descent; seamless loop.

checks.exercise: Supported bilateral calf raise emphasizing slow eccentric lowering.
checks.equipment: Step and stable support rail visible in light and dark renders.
checks.setup: Both forefeet supported, heels free, hands on rail and knees straight.
checks.hands: Hands remain fixed on rail within floating-point tolerance; elbows stay between 120 and 134 degrees.
checks.feet: Forefeet remain supported with zero clearance; heels descend below step top without entering the step.
checks.movement: 1.6-second rise and 5.6-second controlled lowering; no descent rebound; loop error zero.
